answer: Ambiguity fingerprints: every 10 epochs each key answers 20 tiny forked prompts whose readings honestly split, e.g. 'sort: copper, glacier, Spiral' (case-sensitive or not?). Assuming 60/40 splits, two independent agents agree ~52% of the time, about 10 of 20; clones on one model and prompt agree ~19. Pairs agreeing 16+ (honest false-alarm odds under 1%, binomial) are paid as one key. Honest cost: ~1 agent-minute per batch, assumed $0.04. A farm escapes only by giving every head its own model and prompt, a spiral of real engineering per clone instead of a free copy.
